title: Taskbar floating causes hovering and selecting in Virtual Desktop indicator/pager widget to not work normally
line: In a panel, every row of the Pager can now be hovered and clicked, including the top and bottom rows.
explanation: The panel view moves clicks that land in the panel's padding inward so applets can be hit at the screen edge. Panel.qml computed that padding as the thick SVG margin plus smallSpacing on all four sides, but the extra spacing only exists at the panel's two ends; on the thickness sides applets just get the SVG margin. With a taller panel the padding (12 px at 46 px) covered the Pager's whole top and bottom rows, so hovers and clicks there were moved into the gap next to them. The change adds smallSpacing only on the panel's length ends (left/right for horizontal panels, top/bottom for vertical ones), so the thickness-side padding matches the applets' real margin again.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: only add spacing to panel padding at the panel's ends

The padding the panel view uses to redirect clicks also added the applet
spacing on the panel's thickness sides, where applets only get the SVG
margin, so the pager's top and bottom rows of desktops never got clicks.

BUG: 488887

 panel's ends

spacing on the panel's thickness sides, where applets only get the SVG
margin, so the pager's top and bottom rows of desktops never got clicks.

BUG: 488887
---
 desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml | 8 ++++----
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
index aea1844c5b..3904f3ee4f 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
@@ -57,10 +57,10 @@ Item {
     readonly property int fixedRightFloatingPadding: floating && (floatingPrefix ? floatingPanelSvg.fixedMargins.right  : 8)
     readonly property int fixedTopFloatingPadding: floating && (floatingPrefix ? floatingPanelSvg.fixedMargins.top    : 8)
 
-    readonly property int topPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.top + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
-    readonly property int bottomPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
-    readonly property int leftPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.left + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
-    readonly property int rightPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.right + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int topPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.top + (verticalPanel ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0), spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int bottomPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom + (verticalPanel ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0), spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int leftPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.left + (verticalPanel ? 0 : Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing), spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int rightPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.right + (verticalPanel ? 0 : Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing), spacingAtMinSize));
 
     readonly property int minPanelHeight: translucentItem.minimumDrawingHeight
     readonly property int minPanelWidth: translucentItem.minimumDrawingWidth

media.caption: Master, 46 px floating panel, 10 desktops in 5 rows: hovering a top-row desktop shows no highlight and clicking it does nothing
Master: hovering a bottom-row desktop shows no highlight and clicking it does nothing
With the fix: the hovered top-row desktop is highlighted and clicking it switches to it
With the fix: the hovered bottom-row desktop is highlighted and clicking it switches to it

review.text: The cause is real: in 6a6464a246 smallSpacing was added to all four paddings, but the panel containment only adds rowSpacing at the length ends (dropArea left/right margins in main.qml), so PanelView redirected clicks on the Pager's edge rows. Limiting smallSpacing to the length ends brings the exported padding back in line with the real applet area. It's tested for horizontal and vertical panels and for edge clicks on Kickoff, and the media show the edge rows highlighting.
